hooks.text: 装备没有固定槽位，可旋转后塞入有限背包，为主角和每名同伴分别安排装备布局。
hooks.excerpt: You need to collect a separate set of equipment for the hero and each companion. Items do not have fixed slots. You can rotate them and place them in the inventory as long as there is free space.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 物品光环会强化相邻格武器或护甲，移动一格就可能改变整套构筑。
hooks.excerpt: Some items have auras that strengthen weapons or armor in adjacent cells. Sometimes moving an item by a single cell is enough to change the entire build.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每个生态区结束时从两块Boss部件中选一块，逐步拼出最终要亲自面对的Guardian。
hooks.excerpt: At the end of each biome, you choose one of two boss parts. Each part changes the Guardian's appearance and power. After completing all biomes, you will have to face the final boss.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
